_note: zh display-only glosses, keyed by the pack headword `w` -> text shown when a passage span of that word is tapped. passages (langs/zh.py ZhLinker) writes it as the span's optional 4th element; words.json `en`, drills, links, counts and budgets never see it. Source: zh passages QA table (2026-09-25).
点: o'clock; a little (一点, 有点); to order (food); point; dot
上: on, in (N上); last (上个月); to go to (上课, 上班); to go up; to get onto
下: next (下个, 下次); to fall (下雨, 下雪); to finish (下班, 下课); under; down; (V+一下) briefly, a bit
会: will; be likely to; can (know how to); meeting (开会)
还: still; also (还有, 还要); (huán) to return
越: (越来越) more and more; to exceed
就: then; just; right away; as early as
开: to open; to drive (开车); to hold (a meeting)
过: to cross; to spend, celebrate (过生日); to live (过得)
位: polite measure word for people; position
家: home; family; measure word for firms and shops
场: measure word for games and shows; place
张: measure word for flat things; to open up
条: measure word for long things (rivers, lines); strip
有: to have; there is; (有的) some; (有时候) sometimes; (有点) a bit
起来: to get up; (V+起来) when doing, starting to
找: to look for; to give change
包: bag; (红包) red envelope; to wrap
叫: to be called; to call; to shout
_extra: Keys after 让 were added by the builder side from --check context (not in the QA table).
在: at, in (在+place); to be (located) at; (在+V) doing, in the middle of
想: to want to, would like to; to think; to miss
回: to go back, return (回家); measure word for times
多: many; much; more (多穿); how (多长, 多大); over (一个多小时)
对: to, towards, for (对…好, 对…有兴趣); right; correct
阿姨: auntie (polite address for a woman); maternal aunt
日: day (星期日, 十月八日); sun
请: please; to invite, to treat (我请你); to ask
做: to do; to make; to cook (做菜)
好: good; well; OK; (V+好) done, ready (做好)
到: to arrive; to (从…到…); (V+到) to manage to (找到, 看到)
进: to enter, go into (进来, 住进); to advance
带: to bring, take (带来); band; belt
接: to pick up, meet (sb); to receive; to answer (the phone)
路: road; journey; route (十五路, bus number)
